name: GenHub Alpha v0.0.3
body:
## GenHub Alpha Release v0.0.3

### 📦 Installation

**First-time users (Windows):**
- **Installer (Recommended):** Download `GenHub-win-Setup.exe` and run it
- **Portable:** Download `GenHub-0.0.3-win-portable.zip`, extract, and run `GenHub.Windows.exe`

**Existing users:**
- The app will auto-update using Velopack (installer version only)
- Portable users: Download the new portable zip manually

### 🆕 What's New

**11 commits** merged from development branch:

- **Profile & Content Management**
    - **Multi-Pool Storage**: Introduced 'Primary' and 'Installation' pools to support cross-drive setups; separated map and replay files per profile. ([`f531cf8d`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/f531cf8d))
    - **Game Profile Orchestration**: Refactored profile creation into a centralized service model supporting multi-variant publisher clients. ([`bdaa81a8`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/bdaa81a8))
    - **Direct Content Linking**: Added ability to add downloaded content to profiles directly from the Downloads view with conflict detection. ([`b3d5a224`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/b3d5a224))
    - **User Data Linking**: Implemented dynamic linking for user-specific content including maps, missions, and replays. ([`2425513b`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/2425513b))
    - **Content Deletion**: Users can now delete downloaded content from storage with safety checks. ([`02496ba0`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/02496ba0))

- **Game Compatibility & Settings**
    - **GameSpy & Network**: Added GameSpy IP support and improved persistence for `GameSettings`. ([`f531cf8d`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/f531cf8d))
    - **Steam Integration**: Added a "Steam Launch Mode" toggle and implemented `SteamManifestPatcher`. ([`cc959ae5`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/cc959ae5))
    - **CDISO Detection**: Added support for detecting CDISO installations on both Windows and Linux. ([`fb3af4cc`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/fb3af4cc))
    - **Local Content**: New button in settings for manual file imports. ([`f531cf8d`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/f531cf8d))

- **Release & CI/CD**
    - **Portable Builds**: Automated the creation of portable Windows (.zip) builds. ([`97270a24`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/97270a24))
    - **Automated Changelogs**: Integrated logic to generate changelogs between `main` and `development`. ([`97270a24`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/97270a24))

- **Settings & UI Redesign**
    - **Path Clarification**: Renamed `ContentStoragePath` to `ApplicationDataPath`. ([`8e85b4b8`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/8e85b4b8))
    - **"Danger Zone"**: Added real-time storage stats and destructive management actions. ([`8e85b4b8`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/8e85b4b8))
    - **UI Optimization**: Redesigned Settings view with Expanders and updated `ComboBox` styling. ([`8e85b4b8`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/8e85b4b8))
    - **Tooltips**: Added workspace strategy tooltips for better UX clarity. ([`02496ba0`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/02496ba0))

- **Bug Fixes & Maintenance**
    - **Performance**: Progressive profile loading for a more responsive UI. ([`bdaa81a8`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/bdaa81a8))
    - **Asset Loading**: Fixed missing cover images and improved robust image conversion. ([`cc959ae5`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/cc959ae5))
    - **Graphics**: Fixed "Very High" texture rejection bug. ([`f531cf8d`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/f531cf8d))
    - **Code Quality**: Updated StyleCop, resolved warnings, and refactored repository models. ([`130c659e`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/130c659e), [`8e85b4b8`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/8e85b4b8))
    - **Merge Info**: Initial merge from development branch. ([`f156e5e0`](https://github.com/community-outpost/GenHub/commit/f156e5e0))

### 📝 Build Information
- **Version:** 0.0.3
- **Commit:** 4f9dc33
- **Channel:** Release

### 🔧 Assets Included
- `GenHub-win-Setup.exe` - Windows installer (auto-updates)
- `GenHub-0.0.3-win-portable.zip` - Windows portable (no installation required)
- `GenHub-{version}-win-full.nupkg` - Windows update package
- `GenHub-{version}-linux-full.nupkg` - Linux update package
- `RELEASES` - Windows update metadata
